recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Open a new OO issue only if the work group wants specific examples or guidance for semantic versioning or FHIR conformance under the current Device.deviceVersion and Device.conformsTo model.
issue_request: FHIR-32681 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification OO request to improve Device documentation for software/application use cases, including more prominent scope text, rudimentary version/conformance guidance, and a software-system example. Its final disposition was to accept the Device Scope-Boundary-Relationships document through FHIR-20574 for R5.
initial_application: Commit f223f3ea90a8e83886dd5c9ca7ce631cbcdad9cd added Device/example-software to the active examples list. Commit 3c23148747a7d0fead21ff9afaab2fc3bb65eae9 explicitly listed FHIR-32681 while applying the FHIR-20574 Device scope/boundary rewrite. Commit 46df16de1a75a439135626c6260c2b9856be633d later refined the software category wording through FHIR-35984.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini and owned by OO. Later R6 edits, especially 3cf635fa2b606d038462a683a53338e39b3f30e3, removed long category definitions from Device while retaining the software scope/category wording and pointing to DeviceDefinition for details. FHIR-38058 later resolved no-change for broader Device specialization/conformance wording, supporting the choice not to invent FHIR/semver-specific guidance under this seed.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/device/device-introduction.xml explicitly says medical devices may include software and non-medical devices may include software applications or algorithms; list-Device-examples.xml lists Device/example-software; codesystem-device-category.xml includes a software code; and structuredefinition-Device.xml includes general Device.deviceVersion and Device.conformsTo elements.

related_jiras.note: Accepted the Device Scope-Boundary-Relationships document that formally disposed FHIR-32681 and sibling Device scope issues.
Later explicit Device software-scope issue refined the same category sentence and already has an audit commit on the combined branch.
Later no-change decision around Device specialization/conformance wording supports not adding speculative FHIR-conformance guidance for this seed.
